steps.title: Initial Consultation
steps.desc: We start by understanding your rental goals and walk you through how Chapter manages your property.

steps.title: Property Evaluation
steps.desc: We assess your property's rental value based on location, size, condition, and amenities.

steps.title: Marketing Strategy
steps.desc: We create a custom marketing plan with professional photography and targeted advertising to attract quality tenants.

steps.title: Tenant Screening
steps.desc: We run thorough background checks, employment verification, and rental history reviews.

steps.title: Lease Agreement
steps.desc: We prepare a compliant lease outlining terms, rent, duration, and responsibilities.

steps.title: Move-In Inspection
steps.desc: We document the property's condition in detail to protect your interests.

steps.title: Periodic Inspections
steps.desc: We monitor your property over time to catch maintenance issues early.

steps.title: Rent Collection & Maintenance
steps.desc: We handle rent payments and coordinate repairs so you don't have to.

steps.title: Regular Communication
steps.desc: We keep you informed throughout the tenancy with clear, consistent updates.

steps.title: End-of-Tenancy Inspection
steps.desc: We complete a final assessment and handle the deposit per Manitoba's Residential Tenancies rules.
